# Comprehensive test of leap year rules
from src.leap import is_leap_year, days_in_month

# According to Gregorian calendar rules:
# - A year is a leap year if it is divisible by 4
#   - EXCEPT end-of-century years that must be divisible by 400

leap_years = [1600, 2000, 2400, 2800, 3200]  # Divisible by 400 -> leap
non_leap_years = [1700, 1800, 1900, 2100, 2200, 2300, 2500, 2600, 2700, 2900]  # Not divisible by 400 -> not leap

regular_leap = [1604, 1704, 1804, 1904, 2004, 2024, 2028]  # Divisible by 4 but not 100 -> leap

print('Divisible by 400 (should be leap):')
for y in leap_years:
    expected = True
    actual = is_leap_year(y)
    status = '✓' if expected == actual else '✗'
    print(f'{status} {y}: expected={expected}, actual={actual}')

print()
print('Divisible by 100 but not 400 (should NOT be leap):')
for y in non_leap_years:
    expected = False
    actual = is_leap_year(y)
    status = '✓' if expected == actual else '✗'
    print(f'{status} {y}: expected={expected}, actual={actual}')

print()
print('Divisible by 4 but not 100 (should be leap):')
for y in regular_leap:
    expected = True
    actual = is_leap_year(y)
    status = '✓' if expected == actual else '✗'
    print(f'{status} {y}: expected={expected}, actual={actual}')

# Test days_in_month edge cases
print()
print('Days in month tests:')
# Feb 2024 (leap year) -> 29
assert days_in_month(2024, 2) == 29
print('✓ Feb 2024: 29 days')

# Feb 2023 (not leap) -> 28
assert days_in_month(2023, 2) == 28
print('✓ Feb 2023: 28 days')

# Feb 1900 (century, not divisible by 400) -> 28
assert days_in_month(1900, 2) == 28
print('✓ Feb 1900: 28 days')

# Apr 2023 -> 30
assert days_in_month(2023, 4) == 30
print('✓ Apr 2023: 30 days')

# Aug 2023 (not in list of 30-day months) -> 31
assert days_in_month(2023, 8) == 31
print('✓ Aug 2023: 31 days')

# Jan 2023 -> 31
assert days_in_month(2023, 1) == 31
print('✓ Jan 2023: 31 days')

print()
print('All tests passed!')
"
